jobs.title: Creative Operations AI Transformation Strategist
jobs.description:
**Location: NYC (hybrid \- 3x onsite)**
  

**Job Type: 8\-month W2 hourly contract (extension/conversion based on performance)**
  

**Compensation Range: $60\-67/hr**
  

**Benefits: health/vision/dental, 401k, and more (https://shorturl.at/GMPcb)**
  

  

Brand is advancing a multi\-year transformation to build an AI\-enabled, integrated, and agency\-light content operating model. This involves Adobe\-enabled transformation, creative workflow redesign, selective in\-housing of production/post\-production, marketer self\-service, digital asset management (DAM), agency optimization, and value realization.
  

  

We are seeking a strategic, hands\-on transformation leader to turn emerging AI capabilities into practical, governed, and scalable ways of working. Partnering across Brand Creative, Creative Operations, Brand AI Transformation, Finance, Sourcing, Marketing Transformation, Product, Tech, Legal, Risk, and agencies, this role determines which work moves in\-house, stays with agencies, operates hybrid, or becomes marketer self\-service.
  

  

This is not a traditional finance, project coordinator, or tech\-product role. The ideal candidate combines transformation strategy, creative ops, AI fluency, operating\-model design, and commercial discipline to assess ambiguous workflows, establish facts, recommend future\-state models, mobilize stakeholders, and execute roadmaps with measurable business cases.
  

  

**Primary Outcomes**

* Define the future\-state creative and content operating model.
* Identify and prioritize viable in\-housing opportunities (creative, production, post\-production, high\-volume adaptation).
* Translate creative and business needs into clear Adobe and enterprise\-tech requirements.
* Design and execute pilots validating quality, speed, capacity, controls, and economics before scaling.
* Establish an agency\-light model preserving external partners for high\-value strategy, original creative, specialist craft, and variable capacity.
* Build credible value cases connecting workflow changes to agency\-scope and budget decisions.
* Create operating mechanisms to sustain capabilities post\-transformation.

**Responsibilities:**
  

**Transformation strategy and operating\-model design**


* Lead current\-state assessments of creative, production, post\-production, and asset\-management workflows to resolve fragmentation, handoffs, rework, and capacity constraints.
* Design future\-state workflows, roles, decision rights, governance forums, service tiers, and handoffs across internal teams and agencies.
* Recommend work allocation across four delivery models: in\-house, agency, hybrid, and marketer self\-service based on value, complexity, volume, risk, craft, automation potential, and capacity.
* Translate strategy into sequenced roadmaps, implementation requirements, decision points, and measurable outcomes.
* Ensure pilots have a clear path to operationalization, ownership, training, support, and steady\-state delivery.

**Creative operations and in\-housing strategy**


* Assess creative workflows from brief/intake through concept, production, review, approval, delivery, trafficking, and archiving.
* Evaluate opportunities across photography, video, motion graphics, retouching, versioning, resizing, templates, and social content.
* Develop make\-versus\-buy assessments evaluating quality, speed, cost, capacity, risk, expertise, and demand variability.
* Define the talent, skills, capacity, workflow, and technology needed to internalize selected work.
* Establish pilot criteria and scale gates (quality, utilization, turnaround, rework, stakeholder acceptance, unit economics).
* Support the transition of approved work from agencies to internal teams, including scope definition, knowledge transfer, documentation, and readiness.
* Partner with Sourcing and Finance to align in\-housing plans with agency contracts, retainers, and SOWs.

**AI and Adobe capability strategy**


* Translate creative jobs\-to\-be\-done into structured business, workflow, data, governance, and tech requirements.
* Assess where AI can automate or augment work versus where human judgment and specialist craft must remain primary controls.
* Partner with Adobe, Product, and Tech teams to evaluate relevant tools (Creative Cloud, Firefly, Firefly Services, Adobe Express, GenStudio, Frame.io, AEM Assets, Workfront), distinguishing out\-of\-the\-box, configuration, integration, and new\-build needs.
* Design use cases and pilots with explicit inputs, outputs, success criteria, human review points, and handoffs.
* Evaluate AI outputs for strategic fit, quality, brand consistency, repeatability, rights, and control readiness.
* Help establish responsible\-AI practices, including approved boundaries, human review, documentation, transparency, brand governance, and escalation paths.
* Remain technology\-agnostic to avoid forcing workflows into ill\-fitting tools.

**Workflow, data and governance**


* Define intake requirements, standardized briefs, workflow stages, approval paths, exception handling, and SLAs.
* Establish data requirements to measure demand, capacity, cycle time, revision rounds, automation, asset reuse, spend, and value.
* Partner with Workfront and DAM teams to improve asset traceability from request through storage.
* Define requirements for metadata, taxonomy, naming, rights, ownership, approval evidence, and asset retrieval.
* Develop governance models for templates, self\-service, AI\-assisted content, brand validation, and agency use.
* Clarify responsibilities and handoffs among transformation teams, Creative Ops, Brand Creative, DAM, Legal, Risk, Tech, and business owners.

**Value realization and commercial strategy**


* Build bottom\-up business cases for prioritized in\-housing and automation opportunities.
* Distinguish total external spend, addressable spend, gross avoidable cost, internal delivery cost, and net realized value.
* Connect capability/workflow cha

jobs.title: Creative Director
jobs.description:
**Location**
------------


Remote \- USA


**Employment Type**
-------------------


Full time


**Location Type**
-----------------


Remote


**Department**
--------------


Marketing


**Compensation**
----------------


* $200K – $250K

Where you fall within the compensation range is based on how you demonstrate the attributes and competencies required for the role. We mostly reserve the upper half of our compensation bands for internal growth. During your call with one of our recruiters, they can further clarify the salary range and our total compensation.


Overview**The Problem**
---------------


Flock's creative group is expanding as the company raises its standard of visual storytelling and campaign execution across brand, film, and digital experiences. This momentum creates a need for unified creative leadership to turn complex technology and public safety outcomes into compelling, human\-centered narratives. You will own that direction, driving the creative concept, visual identity, and craft bar across design, film, and motion.


**What You'll Own**
-------------------


* Direct integrated campaigns, product launch narratives, and flagship brand films from initial concept through final delivery.
* Define and maintain the visual, cinematic, and editorial standards across design, motion, and video production to build a recognizable creative signature.
* Lead and mentor multidisciplinary craft teams, guiding discipline leads in art direction, storytelling, and creative critique.
* Establish operational systems, including reference libraries, templates, and production guidelines, that elevate quality while improving delivery speed.
* Partner with brand strategy and production leadership to translate executive goals into clear creative briefs and execution plans.

**What This Role is Not**
-------------------------


* This is not a hands\-off review role, you will actively shape concepts, guide edits, direct art execution, and refine details across all mediums.
* This isn't a high\-volume template production management job, your main focus is establishing concept quality and narrative depth.
* This is not an isolated brand strategy position, you will work directly alongside production and cross\-functional teams to ship live campaigns.

**What You Bring**
------------------


* Proven track record leading multidisciplinary creative teams across art direction, design, motion, and cinematic film production.
* Deep portfolio demonstrating high\-craft visual design alongside narrative documentary or high\-paced commercial storytelling.
* Advanced fluency in the complete production lifecycle, including typography, editing pace, color grading, sound design, and finishing standards.
* Experience setting practical brand guidelines, design systems, and creative review frameworks for internal teams and agency partners.
* Ability to direct campaigns that balance emotional human narrative with clear technical product messaging.

**Compensation**
----------------


In this role, you'll receive a starting salary between $200,000 and$250,000 as well as Flock Stock Options. Base salary is determined by job\-related experience, education/training, as well as market indicators. Your recruiter will discuss this in depth with you during our first chat.


**Why Flock**
=============

Every community deserves to be safe. Flock builds the technology that makes that real: last year we supported over 1 million criminal investigations and helped locate more than 10,000 missing people. We're 1,700 people building the impossible with over $1B in funding, and the expectations are high on purpose. If you want a role where the stakes are real and the pace matches, this is it.


Some problems get solved faster in the same room, so we prioritize candidates in Atlanta and Boston. Hub\-based roles mean real in\-person time with your coworkers. Remote roles exist, and when a posting is open to remote work, it says so.


The impossible takes every kind of mind. Flock is an equal opportunity employer, and we know the best solutions come from diverse perspectives, experiences, and skills working together with mutual respect. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, email recruiting@flocksafety.com; your information stays confidential and is used only to arrange the right accommodation for your interviews.


On compensation. We pay fairly for the work. Base salary is determined by job\-related experience, education, training, and market indicators. The range in this posting covers base salary only and doesn't include equity, sales bonus plans where applicable, or benefits. The range may be adjusted over time, and this posting may span more than one career level.


One last thing. All legitimate communication from Flock comes from an email ending in @flocksafety.com or noreply@ashbyhq.com. We never make offers through messaging apps or third parties, and we never request payment or sensitive personal information during hiring. If you encounter suspicious outreach about a Flock role, report it to recruiting@flocksafety.com.


Compensation Range: $200K \- $250K
